verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged after a host and credential swap. It also states that BI and dashboard tools such as Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau and DBeaver connect directly, so no custom glue is needed. missing for 10: explicit naming of JDBC/ODBC drivers, per-tool BI setup guides beyond a list of names, independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard connectivity.
